newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade volume dives on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade volume dives on weak demand.

text.p: TradeD volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dived to 680 kg on Friday from Thursday's 1,542 kg on weak demand, dealers said.
Gold closed higher at $326.00 an ounce and 1,663,500 lira per gram, compared to $323 and 1,637,500 lira on Thursday.
"Demand was low in the market as sellers widened their profit margin," a broker said.
The lira closed easier at 158,050 lira to the dollar from previous 157,530 lira on Thursday.
Most of the Friday's trade, 660 kg, took place in the morning session.
